Class ResearchPaper

java.lang.Object
com.uni.models.ResearchPaper
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ResearchPaper>
public class ResearchPaper extends Object implements Serializable, Comparable<ResearchPaper>
Academic paper authored by one or more Researchers. Comparable by date (newest first) by default; comparators for citations and pages live in com.uni.comparators.
